My script snippets

Snippets that appear in the script editor “Insert snippet” dropdown. Stored locally, not overwritten by extension updates.

Snippet library storage

Extension storage is shared across all tenants in this browser. IndexedDB keeps a separate library per tenant. Use Export / Import to copy snippets between the two.

Add / edit snippet

Pasted code: literal backslash-n (\n) is converted to newlines. Name must be unique.
